title: skills: teach report chart seriesBy in the objectstack-ui dashboards rule
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibx5r5nhDMwpRs4SL6D

Filing gate: ③ the `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` line of PR #28191 (#27974), filed by the seat before ACCEPT as the claim template requires. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the lane and grade.
Reach: an AI author writing a report chart from the `objectstack-ui` skill does not learn `seriesBy`, so it keeps writing the owner × stage `matrix` workaround.

## Wanted

- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md` (the report example that teaches `chart`) shows `seriesBy`: a second dimension of the bound dataset that splits the one `yAxis` measure into a series per value; it must name a declared dimension (publish refuses an unknown name).
- Lands with or after the renderer card for #27974, so the skill never teaches a key that draws nothing. Governed path (`skills/**`): Tier H.

Links back: #27974, PR #28191.

Blocked-by: #28206
